Brawler Tiny is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One.
“
Why d'ya keep botherin' me? One more step and I'll bite yer nose off.
„
— Tiny (Goblin)

Involvement

Act One

Brawler Tiny is in the outdoor eastern courtyard of the Goblin Camp, listening to  Crusher's boasting. If a party member starts combat with Crusher, Tiny,  Breg, and  Kirz join the fight on Crusher's side. If the party member defeats Crusher, Tiny walks to the main area next to the cooking spit and expresses fear toward the party.
